abstract: OBJECTIVE: To investigate the clinicopathological features, prognostic factors, treatment, clinical response, and outcome of gestational choriocarcinoma (GCC). MATERIALS AND METHODS: A retrospective review was made of the clinicopathological and survival data of 13 patients who were diagnosed and treated for GCC in two referral centers in Turkey between 1992 and 2020. RESULTS: The median age of patients was 36 years (range, 27-54 years), and seven were ≤39 years. The antecedent pregnancy was a term in nine (69.2%) cases, and the risk score was ≥7 in 11 (84.6%). According to the International Federation of Gynecology and Obstetrics 2009 staging, eight cases were in stage I, two in stage III, and three in stage IV. With the exception of one patient, all the others received combination chemotherapy (CT), and two of those were also treated with radiotherapy. Chemoresistance developed in 50% (6/12), and second-line CT was given to four of these. The overall complete response rate was 69.2%. Four patients died of chemoresistance and disease progression, all of them were with antecedent-term pregnancy, had high scores ≥7, and had metastases. CONCLUSION: GCC is a unique subtype of gestational trophoblastic neoplasia, which differs from others in terms of poor prognosis, a frequent tendency to early metastasis, and resistance to treatment. To be able to achieve the most efficient therapy and prognosis, histopathology-based risk models should be developed.
abstract_ja: 目的：妊娠性絨毛癌（GCC）の臨床病理学的特徴、予後因子、治療、臨床反応、および転帰を調査すること。材料および方法：1992年から2020年にかけてトルコの2つの紹介センターでGCCの診断と治療を受けた13例の患者の臨床病理学的および生存データの後方視的レビューを行った。結果：患者の中央年齢は36歳（範囲27～54歳）で、7例が39歳以下であった。先行妊娠は9例（69.2%）で分娩であり、リスクスコアは11例（84.6%）で7以上であった。国際産科婦人科連合2009年の病期分類によれば、8例が病期I、2例が病期III、3例が病期IVであった。1例を除いてすべての患者が化学療法の併用療法を受け、このうち2例は放射線療法も受けた。化学療法耐性は50%（6/12）で発現し、このうち4例が二次化学療法を受けた。全奏効率は69.2%であった。化学療法耐性と疾患進行により死亡した4例の患者はすべて先行分娩妊娠を有し、スコア7以上の高リスク、および転移を有していた。結論：GCCは妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の独特な亜型であり、不良な予後、早期転移への頻繁な傾向、および治療への耐性の点で他と異なる。最も効率的な治療と予後を達成するためには、病理組織学に基づくリスクモデルを開発する必要がある。
